# Steward

> Steward v0.2.0-alpha.3 is a standalone Rust CLI/TUI for Caddy/Traefik routes, native services, checked plans and recoverable operations. Preserve native identities, explicit authority, ownership, partial coverage and recovery boundaries.

## Start here

- [Full agent guide](https://samishal1998.github.io/steward/llms-full.txt): exact commands, supported authority, JSON/exit semantics and recovery.
- [Get started](https://samishal1998.github.io/steward/guides/quick-start/): API-only inventory, a local app hostname, updates, pause/remove and Traefik watched-directory examples.
- [CLI reference](https://samishal1998.github.io/steward/reference/cli/): command and configuration contracts.
- [Installation](https://samishal1998.github.io/steward/guides/installation/): checksum-verified Linux/macOS installation.
- [Completion](https://samishal1998.github.io/steward/guides/completion/): Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell and Elvish.
- [Management workflows](https://samishal1998.github.io/steward/guides/management/): plans/apply, TLS, native services, proxy lifecycle, SSH/container targets, history/rollback, composition and TUI.
- [Export schema](https://samishal1998.github.io/steward/schemas/export.schema.json): versioned read-only AppTrail inventory.

## Operational rules

Check `steward --version` and `--help`; use `--json` for operations. API-only connections are inventory-only. Writes require explicit native authority; direct route and service commands make live changes. Managed plans are apply-ready only with matching owner/state/source/native/tool fingerprints. Profile-only `--config` previews remain non-applicable. Adoption is explicit and checked. On rejected writes inspect `changed`, diagnostics and operation IDs; recover pending work or guard a rollback rather than forcing restoration over drift. Targeted commands execute in the SSH/container target's context.

## Project

- [Repository](https://github.com/samishal1998/steward): source, schemas and synthetic fixtures.
- [Releases](https://github.com/samishal1998/steward/releases): native archives, checksums and pinned installers.
- [Roadmap](https://samishal1998.github.io/steward/project/architecture/): remaining compatibility and implementation gates.
